description: Scaffold a Dataverse solution project (.cdsproj) on disk for source-controlled solution development. Runs 'pac solution init' with the active pac auth profile.

background.description: Run in the background and return a jobId immediately, for a command that takes longer than the client will wait. Poll cs_job_status.

cwd.description: Working directory for pac (for project commands: the solution project folder)

profile.description: pac auth profile to run as: the admin account for tenant commands. Defaults to CPS_ADMIN_PROFILE for admin commands and CPS_PAC_PROFILE otherwise, then the active profile. cs_init lists the profiles.

name: cs_init_solution_project
title: Create a solution project
